setup_steps: Update the TrackIR software first (Help → Check for game updates) - MSFS 2024 requires a recent profile.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack BEFORE MSFS; both apps must run at the same admin level (both as admin, or neither).
Uninstall any competing tracker software (Tobii Game Hub etc) - they can silently toggle TrackIR off.
In-game: Options → Camera → flip the 'TrackIR' switch to On.
If still not detected, run the 'Camera' section's 'Reset all to defaults' then re-enable.

native_games.notes: SimConnect-based; same driver chain as MSFS 2024.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE MSFS 2020.
In-game: Options → Camera → 'TrackIR Enabled' → On.
If TrackIR isn't picked up, make sure both the tracker and MSFS are running at the same admin level.
Numpad 5 recenters the view; Options → Camera → 'Reset Camera View' rebinds the hotkey if collision.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE iRacing.
iRacing auto-detects TrackIR - no in-game enable required.
Recenter the view with the semicolon (;) key (Recenter HMD); Y recenters tilt only.
Tune head behaviour via the in-sim Camera Tool: from the session screen press Ctrl+F12 to open it and adjust 'Driver Head Horizon' (Roll / Pitch chassis) and related sliders.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Assetto Corsa.
AC auto-detects TrackIR and FreeTrack - no menu toggle.
In-game: Options → View → set 'Lock onto Horizon' to ~50% for natural motion.
If using Content Manager: Settings → Content Manager → Miscellaneous → enable the TrackIR profile.
Edit <Documents>\Assetto Corsa\cfg\camera_onboard.ini for fine tuning (FOV, head offsets).
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE ACC.
ACC auto-detects TrackIR - there's no in-game on/off toggle.
In-game: Settings → View → set 'Lock to Horizon' to ~50% for a natural feel.
In the TrackIR software's ACC profile, tick 'Exclusive' (under Advanced) or the rotation can double-apply.
If the view jumps on session start, ESC → Default the camera offset, then save.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE rFactor 2.
rF2 auto-detects TrackIR; no in-game enable required.

For stronger head-look, edit <rFactor 2 install>\UserData\player\player.JSON (inside the Steam game folder, not Documents). Raise 'Glance Angle' (default 0.75) to 2-3 and/or bump 'Head Rotation' under 'Graphic Options' to 0.3-0.7.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses TrackIR.

setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Arma 3.

In-game: Options -> Controls -> Controllers tab -> click 'TrackIR' in the device list and tick 'Enable TrackIR'. Leave the raw 'FreeTrack' device disabled; OpenTrack's TrackIR output is what the game reads.

Options -> Game -> turn off 'Head bob' so it does not compound with tracker motion.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE War Thunder.
In-game: Options → Controls → Controls Setup → set Control Setup mode to 'Custom'.
Navigate to the 'Camera' section → enable 'Track IR' and bind the axes if they're blank.
Head tracking only applies in cockpit / periscope views - third-person is fixed.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE IL-2.
IL-2 Great Battles auto-detects TrackIR - there is no in-game enable toggle. Make sure the TrackIR software recognises the game (update the game list if it doesn't appear).
Settings -> Controls -> Camera -> 'Camera head rotation' is where you'd optionally rebind the software fallback look keys; you do not need to bind anything for TrackIR.
F9 pauses TrackIR in-cockpit; Numpad 5 recenters.

setup_steps: In OpenTrack, add Output = 'UDP over network'; set Host = 127.0.0.1, port = 4242.
In the FlightGear Launcher: Settings → Additional Settings → add --props=socket,in,30,127.0.0.1,5501,udp to the additional arguments.
Launch your aircraft. In the cockpit: View → Adjust View → Auto-center, then head motion tracks OpenTrack input.
For more granular setup see wiki.flightgear.org/TrackIR - community-maintained and covers alt tracker protocols.
